nina: flagging a pattern: three Dedicated customers saw partial isolation after last week's edge routing tweak. symptoms: intermittent 502s, KV cache slowdowns, and peering resets.
leo: timeline? which customers and dates?
nina: cust-X 04/02, cust-Y 04/04, cust-Z 04/06. all followed small onprem NAT changes.
sam: sounds like packet reordering + asymmetric NAT timeouts we've seen before. any correlate with config pushes?
nina: yes config-rollout-04-01 touched peering rules. sre-bot: monitor: peering-flap-detector triggered 2024-04-02T08:21Z (alert pf-9123).
leo: propose actions: 1) short-term: reduce prefix cache TTL + add per-tenant conservative retry (owner: leo, ticket INF-3210, ETA:48h). 2) mid-term: runbook update + onprem test harness (owner: nina, RB-210, ETA:5d). 3) long-term: cohort regression detector that tags by peering-session (owner: sam, PD-99, ETA:3w).
sam: INF-3210 will include a canary and quick rollback hook. I'll add peering-session id telemetry.
nina: support-bot: please gather vendor firewall logs for cust-Z and cust-Y (vendors: Fortinet, PaloAlto).
support-bot: support tickets created: SUP-1102, SUP-1103.
leo: also verify HSM/KMS latencies during the windows  we saw spikes for cust-Y.
nina: i'll draft the follow-up note for customers and propose maintenance windows (late-night).
sam: blockers: need packet captures from cust-Z to confirm reordering pattern. support-bot: requested.
leo: schedule: daily standup updates until INF-3210 DONE, weekly for PD-99.
sre-bot: reminder: follow-up sync in #incidents in 20h.
nina: marking statuses: INF-3210 (in-progress), RB-210 (wip), PD-99 (planning).
leo: thanks. please keep comms minimal and coordinate with legal for customer notices.
nina: will close loop after canary results. next check-in tomorrow morning.
